propositions: The completion-verify agent step has no tool_step_limit set, leaving the shipped loop-breaker primitive (pydantic-ai tool-call filtering) dormant when runaway cycles exhaust the request budget
Three of four measured production runs enter a repeating tool-call cycle (40-70% redundant calls) and are killed with no verdict, relying on undocumented --force-close as the only exit
The existing loop detector (max_consecutive_repeat) is inverted on real data: it scores cycles as 1 and healthy breadth as 5, making it unsuitable as an actuator trigger
A windowed distinct-ratio discriminator (window 24, trip <=0.50, order-insensitive) fires reliably on pathological runs and never on healthy ones, with a ~5x safety margin

When a runaway is detected during the run, tools must be withdrawn gracefully (or steered with synthetic results) to force the agent to land a verdict on gathered evidence, instead of budget exhaustion killing the run verdict-less
